# Token service

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:token-exchange` · **Epic:** [#81](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/81) · **Tickets:** 5 (2S 3M)

Adds an RFC 8693 token-exchange endpoint on the CP that turns a user's Dex ID token plus an agent's signed assertion into a 15-minute Warden token. Workers can then trust one short-lived, agent-bound token instead of verifying raw IdP tokens.

## How we build it

- `POST /oauth2/token`, form-encoded: grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange, subject_token, subject_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token, client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer, client_assertion, optional audience=warden-worker, scope.
- Subject validation reuses the P1 Dex verifier (iss, aud=warden, exp, nbf, signature via cached JWKS); agent assertion: iss=sub=agent id, aud=<CP token URL>, exp<=5m, jti single-use (jti cache in SQLite with TTL), signed by a key in the agent's registry JWKS.
- Authorization: agent status active, user not in blockedUsers, user groups intersect agent allowed_groups, requested scope subset of default_scope; errors per RFC 6749 (`invalid_grant`, `invalid_client`, `unauthorized_client`, `invalid_scope`) with no detail leakage beyond a reason code.
- Issued JWT (signed by internal/keys purpose=token): iss=<CP URL>, aud=warden-worker, sub=user sub, act={sub: agent id}, groups, sid (stable per user+agent session, ULID), jti, iat, nbf, exp=iat+15m, scope, cnf={jkt: agent key thumbprint}. Response: access_token, issued_token_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt, token_type=Bearer, expires_in=900.
- Per-agent and per-user token-bucket rate limits (default 30/min) keyed in memory; 429 with Retry-After. Every issue/deny written to admin audit as `token.issued` / `token.denied` with sub, agent, sid, reason — never the token.

## Done when

A registered agent exchanging a valid Dex token receives a 15-minute signed Warden token with the specified claims, and every invalid input combination is rejected with the correct OAuth error and an audit record.

### 1/5 · W-P2-TOKX-01

**Add private_key_jwt client assertion verification**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#82](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/82)

In new package internal/tokensvc add `VerifyClientAssertion(ctx, raw, tokenURL) (agentID, jkt string, err)`: parse unverified iss to find the agent in agentreg, select the key by kid, verify with internal/keys.Verify, enforce iss==sub, aud==tokenURL, exp-iat<=5m, and record jti in a `assertion_jti` SQLite table (purged after exp) to reject replays. Reject alg none and any alg not in the agent JWK.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Replayed jti returns invalid_client
- [ ] alg=none and HS256 assertions rejected
- [ ] Assertion signed by a disabled agent's key rejected

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-AREG-01`](agent-registry.md#14--w-p2-areg-01) Add internal/agentreg store and SQLite schema; [`W-P2-KEYS-01`](key-management.md#15--w-p2-keys-01) Add internal/keys Signer interface and local Ed25519/ES256 signers

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-TOKX-02`](token-exchange.md#25--w-p2-tokx-02) Implement token exchange policy checks and JWT minting

### 2/5 · W-P2-TOKX-02

**Implement token exchange policy checks and JWT minting**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#83](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/83)

Add `Service.Exchange(ctx, req) (*Issued, error)` in internal/tokensvc: verify subject via the P1 Dex verifier, check agent status, blockedUsers from the current policy version, group intersection and scope subset, then build claims (iss, aud=warden-worker, sub, act.sub, groups, sid, jti, iat/nbf/exp=15m, scope, cnf.jkt) and sign with the keys purpose=token Signer. sid derived from a `sessions` table keyed by (sub, agent) with a 12h idle TTL.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Claims match the spec exactly in a golden test
- [ ] Blocked user returns invalid_grant with reason user_blocked
- [ ] User outside allowed groups returns unauthorized_client

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-TOKX-01`](token-exchange.md#15--w-p2-tokx-01) Add private_key_jwt client assertion verification; [`W-P2-KEYS-02`](key-management.md#25--w-p2-keys-02) Persist signing keys in secret backend with metadata in CP SQLite

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-TOKX-03`](token-exchange.md#35--w-p2-tokx-03) Mount POST /oauth2/token with RFC 8693 request parsing; [`W-P2-WBND-01`](identity-enforcement.md#15--w-p2-wbnd-01) Verify CP-issued Warden tokens against bundle JWKS

### 3/5 · W-P2-TOKX-03

**Mount POST /oauth2/token with RFC 8693 request parsing**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#84](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/84)

Add the HTTP handler in internal/controlplane (route `/oauth2/token`, POST only, form-encoded, max body 16KB) mapping Service errors to RFC 6749 JSON errors and status codes (400/401/429). Add config keys `tokenService.enabled`, `tokenService.issuer`, `tokenService.ttl` (fixed max 15m) and CLI flag `--token-service` on `proxy control-plane`. Set Cache-Control: no-store.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Wrong grant_type returns unsupported_grant_type
- [ ] Response has no-store and expires_in=900
- [ ] Endpoint absent (404) when tokenService.enabled=false

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-TOKX-02`](token-exchange.md#25--w-p2-tokx-02) Implement token exchange policy checks and JWT minting

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-RCP-01`](identity-client.md#15--w-p2-rcp-01) Extend internal/identityclient with agent keys and token exchange; [`W-P2-TOKX-04`](token-exchange.md#45--w-p2-tokx-04) Add rate limiting and audit for token issuance

### 4/5 · W-P2-TOKX-04

**Add rate limiting and audit for token issuance**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#85](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/85)

Wrap the handler with per-agent and per-sub token buckets (config `tokenService.rateLimit`, default 30/min each) reusing the rate parser from internal/policy where possible; emit `token.issued`/`token.denied` admin audit records and OTel counters `warden_cp_tokens_issued_total{agent}` and `warden_cp_tokens_denied_total{reason}`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] 31st request in a minute returns 429 with Retry-After
- [ ] Audit record never contains the token or subject_token
- [ ] Denial reasons appear as bounded label values

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-TOKX-03`](token-exchange.md#35--w-p2-tokx-03) Mount POST /oauth2/token with RFC 8693 request parsing

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-TOKX-05`](token-exchange.md#55--w-p2-tokx-05) Add token service e2e test with Dex in compose
